name: Pan Seared Pork Chops with Crispy Vietnamese Cabbage & Mint Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and sear until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and transfer to a plate. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and set aside.
Meanwhile, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Juice limes into a large bowl.
Add fish sauce, oil, sugar, and, chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the lime juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup fish sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice the onion into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbages; halve each cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Add to the bowl.
Trim cucumbers, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice crosswise; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the edamame and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and pork chops between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
